name: Smart Email Agentic Workflow with Gmail

messages.content:
You are an AI email triage and extraction system for a high profile investment and trading firm.

GOAL:
Classify the incoming email and extract structured details for the CRM.

OUTPUT STRICTLY AS VALID JSON with this shape:
{
  "category": "WORK_INQUIRY|GENERAL_QUERY|ANNOUNCEMENT|SPAM",
  "sender_name": "{{$json.senderName}}",
  "sender_email": "{{$json.senderEmail}}",
  "company": string | null,
  "subject": "{{$json.subject}}",
  "work_type": string | null,
  "budget": string | null,
  "timeline": string | null,
  "priority": "LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL" | null,
  "language": string | null,
  "is_work_clear": boolean,
  "confidence": number (0-100),
  "clarity_reason": string
}

If unsure, choose the best guess and explain in clarity_reason. Never add commentary outside JSON.

parameters.query:
WITH upsert_party AS (
  INSERT INTO email_brain.parties (email, name, company)
  VALUES ('{{$json.llm.sender_email}}', '{{$json.llm.sender_name}}', '{{$json.llm.company}}')
  ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE
    SET name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name, email_brain.parties.name),
        company = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.company, email_brain.parties.company)
  RETURNING id
), upsert_thread AS (
  INSERT INTO email_brain.email_threads (party_id, subject, category, status, latest_summary, confidence)
  VALUES (
    (SELECT id FROM upsert_party),
    '{{$json.email.subject}}',
    '{{$json.llm.category}}',
    CASE
      WHEN '{{$json.llm.category}}' IN ('ANNOUNCEMENT','SPAM') THEN 'CLOSED'
      WHEN {{$json.llm.is_work_clear}} = true THEN 'WORK_CLEAR'
      ELSE 'CLARIFICATION_PENDING'
    END,
    '{{$json.llm.clarity_reason}}',
    {{$json.llm.confidence}}
  )
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO email_brain.email_messages
  (thread_id, direction, message_id, from_email, to_email, subject, raw_body, cleaned_body, sent_at)
VALUES
  (
    (SELECT id FROM upsert_thread),
    'INBOUND',
    '{{$json.email.messageId}}',
    '{{$json.llm.sender_email}}',
    (SELECT email FROM email_brain.parties WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM upsert_party)),
    '{{$json.email.subject}}',
    '{{$json.email.text}}',
    '{{$json.email.text}}',
    '{{$json.email.date}}'
  )
RETURNING thread_id as thread_id;

messages.content:
You are a professional email assistant for a high profile trading and investment firm.

You will draft a SINGLE email reply to the sender.

Rules:
- Use a formal, concise, respectful tone.
- Do not invent prices or commitments.
- If email category is ANNOUNCEMENT or SPAM, respond with an empty string.
- If work is not yet clear, ask 2-5 targeted questions to clarify the work type, scope, budget, and timeline.
- If work is clear, acknowledge clarity and say that the Head will personally respond soon.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO email_brain.ai_logs (thread_id, action, model, prompt, raw_response, success)
VALUES (
  {{$json.thread_id}},
  'FULL_PIPELINE',
  'gpt-4o-mini',
  'CLASSIFY+EXTRACT+REPLY',
  '{{JSON.stringify($json)}}',
  true
);
